description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
summary: The plugin format is just a directory with a plugin.json manifest, which is exactly the kind of inspectable, composable packaging I want when I'm wiring agent sessions in PenguPool or routing tool calls through AgentOn Pocket. The cli-for-agent entry is the one that made me stop scrolling: it codifies the contract between an agent and a CLI (idempotency, dry-run, structured errors, help-with-examples) as a reusable spec rather than a vibes-based prompt. It's a small but useful artifact for anyone building tools that agents actually need to drive without a human babysitting the terminal.
